title: Argentinian Casserole Delight
description: A hearty and flavorful casserole dish with a mix of beef and vegetables. Perfect for a satisfying dinner.
instructions: Cook the chopped onion until soft, then set aside.
Season the beef with paprika and cook until browned.
Add the red wine and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer until the liquid has thickened.
Stir in the chimichurri sauce and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Transfer the beef mixture to a casserole dish.
Top with chopped parsley and cook in the oven for 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
